steps.text: With the engine stopped, place a container under the strainer or filter and open the drain cock. Loosen the cover nut or bolt just enough to allow the fuel oil to drain out freely. Then close the drain cock. NOTICE: The wiring harness, starting motor or other electrical equipment must be shielded change, since fuel oil can during the filter permanently damage the electrical insulation.
